## REGRESSION (1)

### R1. `src/components/projects/project-map.tsx` — markers no longer refresh when `projects` data arrives or the status filter changes
- **Hunk intent (commit 18ec6e0e7, wave-2 sweep):** stop re-creating the mapbox map on every callback-identity change; introduce "latest-callback mirrors" so marker refreshes always run the newest `addMarkers`.
- **Verdict: REGRESSION** — the refactor removed the only trigger that refreshed markers on data change and never replaced it.
- **Old behavior** (base, line ~432): the map-init effect deps were `}, [mapStyle, styleKey, addMarkers, debouncedAddMarkers, clearMarkers]);`. `addMarkers` is a `useCallback` over `[projects, isXsMobile, isMobileView, getMarkerColor, clearMarkers, clusterMarkers]`, and `projects` comes from `useLiveQuery(getSolarMapCollection(...))` (project-map.tsx:120-123) — async, arrives **after** mount. So on every `projects`/statusFilter change the effect re-ran, the map was torn down and re-created, the `load` handler fired, and markers were rebuilt for the new data.
- **New behavior** (HEAD): effect deps reduced to `}, [mapStyle, clearMarkers]);` (project-map.tsx:468). The refs `addMarkersRef`/`debouncedAddMarkersRef` are kept fresh (lines 409-414), but `addMarkersRef.current(map)` is invoked **only** from the map `load` handler (line 450) and `debouncedAddMarkersRef.current(map)` only from the `zoomend` handler (line 445). Nothing anywhere calls `addMarkers` when `addMarkers`/`projects` changes — the mirror-update effect (line 411) has no consumer for the data-change case.
